t0_derivation: 00:00:00 UTC on the calendar day immediately before the Freeze-1.1 sealing timestamp (Freeze 1.1 §3); unchanged by Freeze 1.2
discovery_day_derivation: first UTC day after the Freeze-1.1 seal; unchanged by Freeze 1.2
runner_invocation_window: any time after remote anchoring and no later than 2026-09-19T08:58:00Z; recommended launch 2026-09-19T08:00:00Z-08:40:00Z

requests.query: open software API catalog CSV JSON
public developer platform registry bulk export

start_mechanism: the registered runner self-times on the SNTP-corrected clock; no human action at 09:00:00Z
interactive_start_assessment: An interactive human- or model-started session cannot guarantee four request starts within +5 s of fixed instants: human reaction, model latency and tool-approval prompts are unbounded, and each later query would need a new action exactly 60 s later. The protocol does not require manual initiation; it requires the registered runner to issue the requests. A pre-launched, self-timed registered runner is therefore the only compliant mechanism, and the tolerance is not widened.
missed_schedule: If the Freeze-1.2 tag is not remotely anchored by the deadline, or the runner fails, the discovery session has failed under Freeze 1.1 §8.2. Freeze 1.2 provides no alternate date; a later prospective amendment would be required.
publication: custodian commits and pushes the whole capture directory and attempts.jsonl after the runner exits and before any source screening
host_requirements: lid open or clamshell with external display
no package upgrades of the registered interpreter
